description: The warrant's validity window ended 2025-12-31, before the package's RFC 3161 genTime (2026-01-01). The warrant was not in force at signing time: fresh=false is reported and the package stays accepted.

reportIncludes: Warrant not in force at signing time: genTime 2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z lies outside valid_from..valid_until.
